design.scope: 32 fresh synthetic trips, eight families. Two initial models, one separate Sonnet corrective review per valid proposal. No memory intervention. Synthetic loss uses supplied cancellation penalties or nonrefundable full charges. Study and later live demo share the same persistent US$1.20 allowance and 256-request cap. No automatic retry; source hashes and all cases frozen before calls.

Bayesian intervals are marginal, prior-dependent and not simultaneous across thresholds or comparisons. Exact tail upper bounds use a separate 5% family across 128 cells; four conditional-dollar sequences use another 5%. Both frequentist families together have union coverage at least 90%, under their respective assumptions. Missing proposal losses remain unknown; execution is known to be zero when no booking is made.
